status: registered initial supplied-law update ruler; scientific acceptance requires complete frozen replay
question: Can a source-keyed incremental ledger retract or replace evidence with the same posterior as independent raw recomputation?
world: A static binary latent state with a positive supplied prior drawn per world. Source reports are independent symmetric noisy observations with reliability 0.6, 0.8 or 1. History lengths 4, 16 and 64 share exactly nested draws.
interventions: True correction and retraction begin with source zero deliberately wrong; false correction begins with source zero true. Other updates use the unchanged generated history. Update labels and true state stay evaluator-only; reader payloads contain source-linked reports and the actual replacement/deletion operation.
implementations: Raw recomputation multiplies source probabilities independently for both states. Incremental ledger stores positive log sums, exact zero counts and removable source factors; each update touches at most two factors, with identical repeats idempotent. It never calls the raw decoder. Append-only adds reports without deleting old factors and ignores retraction; it is an explicitly limited comparator.
conflicts: Certain false reports can make all state masses zero. Record undefined-evidence conflict and use the supplied prior as an explicit common fallback. Removing an offending zero factor must restore valid support. A fallback score is not a posterior under impossible evidence.
cost_scope: Record setup and one-update process CPU separately; shared-host timing is descriptive. Payloads include prior and actual retained records/aggregate state, excluding common executable codec. No latency/storage advantage is presumed.
criterion: Initial method ruler only. Numerical equivalence is necessary, not evidence of latency or storage benefit. Do not continue a superiority claim without measured benefit and correction specificity. No original-world headroom or learned-superiority gate inherited.
fixtures: 12 canonical retraction cases, with truth/prior/posteriors evaluator-only; exercise Sounding Line validator and offline exporter read-only, no live model inference.
full_replay: Complete original finite design from identical frozen source under a new identity.
